options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of the iDRAC.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the iDRAC. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_PASSWORD) is used. I(password) is required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: session_id
options.description: Session ID of the iDRAC. I(session_id) is required when I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the session in an iDRAC. C(present) creates a session. C(absent) deletes a session. Module will always report changes found to be applied when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The https socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: Username of the iDRAC. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_USERNAME) is used. I(username) is required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. I(x_auth_token) is required when I(state) is C(absent).
